newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Vanguard Cellular estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vanguard Cellular estimate cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it lowered its estimate for Vanguard Cellular System Inc's 1997 earnings to $0.31 from $0.51.

-- EVEREN said the move is tied to the company's plan to increase general and administrative expense related to new service offerings and a deferred compensation program designed to retain key personnel.

-- Vanguard is also more exposed to competition among Personal Communications Services (PCS) providers than other stocks EVEREN follows because of its proximity of its larger markets to major metropolitan areas, EVEREN said.
-- Vanguard owns and operates cellular telephone systems.
-- Its shares closed up 1/8 Thursday at 15-1/8.
